events.title: Add token-bucket rate limiting to public endpoints
events.author: Avery Chen
events.body: Applies a per-key token bucket to every public route. Ships the limiter itself; the dashboard for it is not in this change.

events.title: Fix off-by-one in the retry backoff
events.author: Avery Chen

events.title: Export endpoint times out above 50k rows
events.author: Sky Patel
events.body: Reproduced on staging with a 60k-row account. The request hangs and eventually 504s. Needs pagination or a streaming response before the next client onboarding.

events.title: Refactor the settings module
events.author: Avery Chen
events.body: Renames a few things and splits one long file. No behaviour change.
